items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Well right around the corner, this old man, Oaktava or something, a little short, played a whole lot of trumpet.

ctx.x: And Joe Johnson was on the boat too then.

No, Joe Johnson, see them guys wasn't on the boat. Oh, they didn't even go on the boat. See the boat, the boat, the boat, the boat, the boat, in, uh, in 1919 was the first time they had boats, and I'm talking about the way there. Way on there. John Pendleton, them kind of guys. See. And another trumpet player, looked something like, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh, he worked on the boat with us too, on the twilight. On the twilight. Yeah. Well there was another trumpet player living on the road, right around…
Oh, um, Amos White, we saw yesterday, he mentioned a fellow, nobody ever talks about, Hippolyte Charles.
